en.topic_title: Hong Kong police arrest 16 over bar fight murder
en.topic_summary:
Police have arrested 16 people over the killing of a 32-year-old businessmen during a Tsim Sha Tsui bar fight.



Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts. File photo: Hans Tse/HKFP.



The police initially arrested nine men and three women aged between 24 and 52 in connection with the July 26 bar fight which left a beauty consultant dead. Eight of them were charged with murder or assisting offenders, according to a Wednesday statement.
